reports.title: 2026-11-16 Desktop Angebot Search — CSL Sprint5815 €1,199 champion; SYSTEMTREFF Ed76 non-CSL challenger; x-kom price-close comparison
reports.summary: Broad cross-vendor scan with 18 current candidate observations. General-access champion CSL Sprint5815 direct €1,199 + €9.85 Germany DHL = €1,208.85 landed (5700X/RTX5060Ti8/32GB/1TB, ASUS A520M-A II/CSM mATX, 500W CSL Bronze, no OS); ordinary good price, peer-market reference €1,260, 4.84% list discount / 4.06% landed. Exact SKU history flat at €1,199 in 7d/30d/tracked low, but only 3 observations across 2 dates. Best non-CSL functional challenger SYSTEMTREFF Ed76 €1,279.90 + shipping (5700X/Ti8/16GB/WD1TB/B550 ATX/650W be quiet!/WinPro, 3y/30d direct terms); costs €80.90 more before shipping and trades 16GB initial RAM for better ATX/PSU/RDP. Closest price comparison x-kom M3A WinHome €1,289.99, but H610 2-DIMM/64GB and current price +11.30% vs tracked low. NBB Campus €1,249 + €8.99 is conditional; CSL Sprint5548 €1,299 + €9.85 is AM5/Radeon/700W Gold but 16GB/noOS/no CUDA. No 🔥 anomaly. HP Z2 i7-12700K/32GB/UHD770 remains fixed price-less Reference, excluded from market stats.
reports.trend_summary: Sprint5815 7d/30d/tracked low €1,199 flat (3 observations across 2 dates only); SYSTEMTREFF Ed76 €1,279.90 flat in 7d/30d (7 rows); x-kom M3A €1,289.99 vs 7d avg €1,165.83/30d avg €1,161.93/tracked best €1,159, current +€130.99/+11.30%; MemoryPC Ti8 16GB €1,349 is +€90 vs 30d low €1,259 and +€180 vs tracked best €1,169; Alternate €1,199 is stable recently but +€150 vs historical best €1,049. Overall flat to slightly worse; no new low.

additional_candidates.notes: Winner. Direct seller/domain csl-computer.com. 1GbE, no Wi-Fi, no OS; GPU 1 HDMI+3 DP; 3-5 workdays. No independent thermal/noise test; PSU model opaque and only 500W. Market reference €1,260 from current comparable listings, not UVP.

Best non-CSL functional challenger. Direct seller IT-Systemtreff GmbH, domain systemtreff.de. Windows 11 Pro, WD SN3000 1TB, 1GbE, no Wi-Fi by default. 16GB needs upgrade; configurator 32GB adds about €90, taking system to €1,369.90 plus shipping. ATX/650W/WinPro is better for RDP and future GPU than winner, but RAM starts lower.

Closest like-for-like non-CSL price comparator. Windows 11 Home (not a native RDP host), 1GbE, no Wi-Fi, GPU 2 DP+1 HDMI. More CPU cores and 600W PSU than CSL, but 2-DIMM H610/64GB ceiling and current price has risen sharply. Direct x-kom.de retail, not marketplace.

Campus eligibility required. Windows 11 Pro and Wi-Fi included, 32GB/1TB, direct NBB seller. Best conditional remote-ready option if eligible, but motherboard/PSU/GPU VRAM not disclosed; do not assume standard upgrade layout.

Same-seller AM5 long-term alternative, slightly over €1,300 landed. No OS. 16GB DDR5 only; add RAM. Radeon 16GB offers VRAM capacity but no CUDA/OptiX path, so not suitable if engineering workflow depends on NVIDIA CUDA. Better platform/PSU/network than winner.

Direct MemoryPC offer, in stock 3-5 workdays. 16GB DDR5 (2x8), 1TB PCIe4, 650W Gold, no OS. AM5 upgrade path is better than AM4 but 16GB system RAM and Radeon/no-CUDA make it less balanced for the target.
AM5 but 16GB DDR5, 8GB Radeon GPU and no OS. Lower GPU tier than RX9060 XT/RTX5060Ti. Not a balanced replacement at €1,249.
16GB DDR4 and no OS; 650W be quiet! Gold is good, but price is above budget and above its own 30d/historical lows. Direct MemoryPC seller.
RTX5060 non-Ti, 16GB RAM, no OS; 650W Gold PSU but current price is higher than CSL Sprint5815 despite lower GPU and RAM.
Windows 11 Home, 16GB RAM, 500GB SSD and non-Ti RTX5060. Good 650W PSU but 2-DIMM H610 and 64GB ceiling. Current price not competitive against winner.

Platform MediaMarkt Marketplace; actual seller Omiximo B.V. (Nijkerk, Netherlands), seller profile 31 reviews and own repair department. 16GB/512GB, board/PSU unknown. MediaMarkt 30-day voluntary return is for direct MMS sales, not marketplace. Avoid.

Platform Saturn Marketplace; actual seller IT-Systemtreff GmbH (Dorsten), seller profile 265 reviews. Windows 11 Pro, USB Wi-Fi/BT, 32GB, 1TB Crucial E100, but 450W PSU is weak for this GPU and A520 board only 2 DIMM. Saturn 30-day voluntary return excludes marketplace sellers.

Platform Saturn Marketplace; actual seller MYPC OHG (Maxdorf, Germany), seller profile currently 0 ratings. 32GB/1TB/Win11 Pro, ASUS B550-Plus ATX, 600W ADATA, USB Wi-Fi6/BT, 4 fans. €1,399 is over budget; Saturn's 30-day voluntary return excludes third-party sellers.
32GB/1TB/RTX5060Ti8/B550 ATX/650W AZZA Bronze, no OS. Current price is not exceptional relative to in-budget alternatives; only relevant if a 32GB prebuilt and B550 are mandatory.
Same seller and nearly same GPU/RAM/SSD as winner but €50 more, Ryzen 7 5700 rather than 5700X, same A520/500W/noOS; dominated by Sprint5815.
Cheapest new option, but 16GB RAM, RTX5060 non-Ti and 500W PSU; SSD/board details not fully surfaced in short listing. Needs RAM/SSD upgrades for engineering workloads.
32GB/1TB but RTX5060 non-Ti; only €20 less than Sprint5815 landed, so the Ti upgrade in the winner is more valuable. OS/Wi-Fi not included in listing summary.
16GB single-channel DDR4, RX9060XT16, 500W CSL, no OS/no Wi-Fi. Radeon 16GB VRAM can help memory-heavy viewport tasks but no CUDA/OptiX; A520/AM4/500W weak five-year platform.
